verdict.rationale: Bitwarden documents deploying the product on your own Linux server, which lets a user decide where their vault data physically resides; the Public API docs also reference a self-hosted deployment URL. The pack has no evidence of choosing a cloud region or data-residency option in the hosted service, so the story is only met through self-hosting. Missing for 10: hosted cloud region/residency selection (e.g., US vs EU), documented residency guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration of residency control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: This article will walk you through the procedure to install and deploy Bitwarden to your own Linux server.
